info.name: Mechanic Shop API
info.description:
Endpoint tests for the Mechanic Shop API (customers, mechanics, service tickets, inventory).

Start the server with `python app.py` from the project root, then run this collection top to bottom (Customers → Mechanics → Inventory → Service Tickets) — later requests depend on ids and bearer tokens captured by earlier ones via collection variables.

The fixture emails (postman.*@example.com) are chosen not to collide with real seeded data. Re-running the full collection a second time against the same database will fail at the first Create Customer / Create Mechanic step, since those two records are deliberately kept alive (not deleted) to support the Inventory and Service Tickets folders.
